test_policy.notes: Test requirement depends on US-scale GPA for internationals: 3.0-4.0 is admissible without SAT/ACT; 2.5-2.99 needs SAT 880+ or ACT 16+; 2.0-2.49 needs SAT 960+ or ACT 18+. Scores also raise scholarship awards.

requirements.notes: Apply with the UM application or the Common App; the $75 fee cannot be waived for international students. Transcript must cover at least 6 semesters and counts as official only if sent by the school or via Common App. Competitive programs (Honors College, Croft, Pharmacy, etc.) have separate applications.

deadlines.label: Recommended international deadline, fall 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: Admission is rolling with decisions in a few weeks; Ole Miss recommends international students apply before Feb. 1 (fall) or Oct. 1 (spring) to leave time for the visa process. The page prints no year, so it is taken as the current cycle.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Exempt: completed the Intensive English Program Advanced Plus level with a B or higher; 2+ years at and graduation from an accredited U.S. high school (domestic standards then apply); citizens of listed English-speaking countries. Scores must be under two years old. Conditional admission is possible below TOEFL 69 / IELTS 5.5 / PTE 47 (separate Intensive English application). Scores 69-78 TOEFL, 5.5 IELTS or 47-52 PTE may be admitted but must take IE 090/091 in the first term.

english.notes: Tests before Jan. 21, 2026; TOEFL MyBest accepted with the same minimums.
B2 First, C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency score of 169+, no part below 162.

cost.notes: Official COA page, full-time undergraduate: out-of-state tuition $31,068 (12 hours x $1,294.50 x 2 terms; in-state $10,278), capital improvements fee $100 and activity fee $60, housing estimate $8,030 (UM housing ranges $6,134-$16,000) and food $5,580, books $1,200, personal $3,500, travel $3,400 (other_usd = personal + travel); out-of-state total $52,938. International students pay the non-resident rate.

aid.notes: International Academic Excellence scholarships are automatic on admission (no separate application), by US-scale GPA, for 4 years: Mississippi Premier $28,893/yr (3.9-4.0; max 20 awardees per country per year, in order of admission), Champion $12,000 (3.75-3.89), Magnolia $9,500 (3.5-3.74), Legacy $5,000 (3.25-3.49). Separate SAT/ACT scholarships (from $3,000 up to $15,000 at the 3.0-3.49 GPA tier, rising with score) cannot be stacked with them. Need-based aid for internationals is not mentioned.

act.note: The international pages give school code 1840 (SAT and English tests); an ACT code is not listed there.

ielts.note: Submit reports to study@olemiss.edu or directly to UM with code 1840.

duolingo.note: Submit to study@olemiss.edu or directly to UM (code 1840).

pte.note: Submit to study@olemiss.edu or directly to UM (code 1840).

tier_notes.business: Roughly in the 41-100 national band for this field based on widely cited program reputations (editorial judgment, not a sourced figure). Accountancy is the best-known strength.
